test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Centre
solution: The correct answer is '**Periphery**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Centre**' is '**Periphery**'. • **Centre**: the middle point or part of something. (किसी वस्‍तु का मध्य बिंदु या भाग) • *Example: I work in the **centre** of New Delhi.* • **Periphery**: the outer edge of a particular area. (क्षेत्र-विशेष का बाहरी सिरा; परिधि) • *Example: industrial development on the **periphery** of the town...* **Correct Answer:__** *Periphery.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Clear**: easy to see, hear, or understand. (देखने, सुनने या समझने में स्‍पष्‍ट, साफ़) • **Definite**: free of all ambiguity, uncertainty, or obscurity. (सभी अस्पष्टता, अनिश्चितता या अस्पष्टता से मुक्त) • **Mainstream**: the ideas and opinions that are considered normal because they are shared by most people; the people who hold these opinions and beliefs. (अधिकतम लोगों में प्रचलित सामान्‍य विचार और मत; मुख्‍यधारा, सामान्‍य विचार और मत रखने वाले लोग) 195:Tbb4, The correct answer is **'She asked her if she would ready her suit the next day.'**
